blocks: Positive initial prescriptions outside supplied familiar/recently-exposed configurations
gaps.exit: Reviewed familiarization pathway with competence assessment, concrete candidate doses and witnesses by modality/equipment; absence of previous history is not license to default.

gaps.scope: Exact acute fatigue/interference mutation outside familiar supported envelopes
gaps.exit: Applicable named population/configuration/outcome/horizon and bounded recipe choice with comparator KEEP/smaller alternatives and whole-horizon adequacy. No universal set reduction or gap cutoff.

blocks: Positive complete return progression, including14day combined return
gaps.exit: Current capacity/reason/eligible reassessment and subsequent response-driven recipe sequence independently reviewed; not generic percentage of prior week.

blocks: Autonomous combined taper dose or event target outside reviewed witness
gaps.exit: Exact both-sport baseline, event/phase/targets, trade-offs, finite calendar and eligibility supported; endurance aggregate taper not automatic hybrid authorization.

blocks: New HR/pace/power domain equivalence or physiological target
gaps.exit: Versioned method/protocol/construct/uncertainty, exact input binding and conformance examples. RPE/HR percentage/CS not interchangeable with measured lactate threshold.

gaps.owner: Athlete Model/Data + SSCTR; AI/Engineering for future implementation
blocks: Production learning or automatic mutation beyond approved recipe
gaps.exit: Canonical event/compare quality, consent/purpose and storage review plus held-out longitudinal assessment and competent review of false patterns/reversal; qualitative sufficiency is design, not validated prediction.

gaps.owner: Engineering/Quality + affected security/AI owners under next authorization
blocks: Runtime GO for full autonomous coach
gaps.exit: Implement authorized bounded subset; schema-level semantics adapter, deterministic cases, synthetic shadow execution, invariant violations/rollback/observability and independent engineering/quality gates. This mission writes no runtime.

gaps.scope: Human, clinical, service-model and real-use gates
gaps.owner: Founder + qualified human/legal/privacy/release owners when activated
blocks: Unsupported prescriptive publication/real use or efficacy claim
gaps.exit: Clinical qualified human immediately when relevant; single queue funded-human revalidation on actual Founder declaration; separate service/privacy/technical/efficacy gates before dependent use. No invented funding threshold.

gaps.scope: Historical closure gaps and original cases
blocks: Retroactive relabeling of8QUESTIONABLE or blanket G01–G04/C1–C6 closure
gaps.exit: New exact reviewed successor is separately versioned; original89IDs/890cells and0.2candidate remain byte-preserved. New witnesses cannot repair omitted historical inputs.

gaps.rule: A gap has scope/owner/exit evidence and blocks only dependent capabilities. Correct hold is not positive dose coverage. No gap is declared closed merely because a document or agent exists.

engineeringLimits: Finite synthetic contexts, no real athlete/IO integrations
No production persistence, application, exports, confirmation/execution service or concurrency semantics
No empirical/human validation or clinical clearance
No new generic establishment, fatigue, return, taper or calibration engine
Novel changed facts fail closed rather than generalize a profile
Future real service requires separately authorized affected gates
